title: Recorded UK imports: sheep and goat meat (HS 0204)

retrieval.method: HMRC OTS API, server-side $apply aggregation; raw responses cached in pipeline/raw/hmrc/
retrieval.source: 3 queries over consecutive runs of the basket's CN8 codes (URL length), first: https://api.uktradeinfo.com/OTS?$apply=filter(MonthId%20ge%20201901%20and%20(FlowTypeId%20eq%201%20or%20FlowTypeId%20eq%203)%20and%20(CommodityId%20eq%202041000%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202042100%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202042210%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202042230%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202042250%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202042290%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202042300%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202043000%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202044100%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202044210))/groupby((MonthId,FlowTypeId,CountryId,CommodityId,SuppressionIndex),aggregate(NetMass%20with%20sum%20as%20SumNetMass,Value%20with%20sum%20as%20SumValue,$count%20as%20Rows))
retrieval.notes: CN8 codes: 02041000, 02042100, 02042210, 02042230, 02042250, 02042290, 02042300, 02043000, 02044100, 02044210, 02044230, 02044250, 02044290, 02044310, 02044390, 02045011, 02045013, 02045015, 02045019, 02045031, 02045039, 02045051, 02045053, 02045055, 02045059, 02045071, 02045079.
